name: local-delegate
description: Hooks that steer mechanical work (summaries, logs, large files) to the local-delegate MCP tools.

ld_bin.title: Hook interpreter
ld_bin.description: Absolute path of the Python interpreter of the local-delegate uv tool environment. `local-delegate install` fills it in.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the hook messages (es or en). `local-delegate install` fills it in.

pinned_tools.title: Pinned tools
pinned_tools.description: local-delegate tools whose schema stays in the prompt instead of behind ToolSearch (short names such as local_summarize). An empty list turns this off.

commands_enabled.title: Slash commands
commands_enabled.description: The /local-summarize, /local-commit and /local-lint commands of the mod.

status_enabled.title: Status band
status_enabled.description: A band above the prompt with the local backend's state (ready, busy or down, and the mounted model) and this session's delegations, savings and equivalent cost. The Claude quota is left to the status line.

status_style.title: Status band style
status_style.description: How the band looks in the terminal: bar (one row with a background and a state chip) or line (a dim rule over one plain line). Claude Desktop always draws its own row.

read_mod_enabled.title: Read steering by the mod
read_mod_enabled.description: Let the mod, instead of the read hooks, steer large reads to the local tools.
